rows.status: Phase 2 recruiting in 1L advanced cholangiocarcinoma/BTC; prior Phase 1 completed
rows.mechanism: FAP x CD40 tumor-localized CD40 agonist DARPin
rows.n: 75 planned Phase 2 (50 experimental/25 control); prior Ph1 all-comer n=46
rows.orr: BTC NR; prior Ph1 all-comer 1 unconfirmed PR/46

rows.status: Phase 1/2a active-not-recruiting; optimized/densified dose regimens tested
rows.mechanism: CD33 x CD123 x CD70 x CD3 tetraspecific T-cell engager DARPin
rows.line: R/R AML or MDS/AML; monotherapy/obinutuzumab pretreatment; AZA/VEN combo expansion listed
rows.safety: Grade >=3 MP0533-related TEAEs reported; DR9 IRR/CRS mainly first week with no Grade 3 events; obinutuzumab feasible

rows.mechanism: CD33 x CD123 x CD70 x CD3 tetraspecific T-cell engager DARPin
rows.n: 14 MDS/AML patients in DR1-9; pooled 54 treated/48 evaluable
rows.safety: Pooled safety; Grade >=3 MP0533-related TEAEs reported; DR9 IRR/CRS no Grade 3 events

rows.status: Phase 1/2a recruiting; dosing ongoing; initial clinical data expected in 2026
rows.mechanism: DLL3-targeted 212Pb alpha radioligand DARPin with 203Pb imaging/dosimetry surrogate
rows.line: SCLC after >=2 prior systemic therapies or not eligible for standard 2L; DLL3-positive
rows.n: 138 planned total; SCLC/LCNEC expansion n=30; first imaging/dosimetry data n=5
rows.orr: NR; ORR is Phase 2a expansion primary endpoint
rows.safety: First 203Pb imaging/dosimetry showed specific tumor uptake and limited healthy tissue uptake; 212Pb efficacy/safety immature
rows.source: NCT07278479; TWC 2026 release; ASCO/SNMMI 2026 MP0712 poster
